text:
I wrote the review to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/25/session-53d50878/task-mastermind-3/review.md` with verdict: fix. I could not check the work against what the owner asked, because `requirements.md` is missing from the task folder. The folder holds only `past-work.md`, `session.jsonl` and `review/diff.patch`, and `session.jsonl` has just the assign line and a commit id.

The four `[fix]` findings:
- **No requirements:** a fresh agent could not continue from this folder.
- **Diff covers only part of the work:** the task title mentions `Chat.js` and `Chat.css`, but the diff has only `scroll.md`, `Widget.js` and `voice-assistant.md`. I confirmed `Widget.PIN_BOTTOM` exists in `Widget.js` but could not see the Chat code that `scroll.md` describes.
- **Stale doc:** `voice-assistant.md:60` ("Nothing jumps") still says pinning the newest line to the bottom was rejected, which is now the default.
- **Observer runs in both modes:** the new MutationObserver in `Widget.js` calls `anchor()` even when `PIN_BOTTOM` is false.

There are also three `[note]` findings. `test/anchor.mjs` only proves the non-default mode. The old "within 4px" wording may linger in other docs. No page changed, so there are no shots and I skipped the layout, sizing and colour checks.

I made no code edits.

I rewrote the asks section of `requirements.md`; the rest of it already read clearly.

The six asks and the separate proof table are now six ticked checklist items, each with its proof beside it. The old layout made a reader match numbers across two places. I did not shoot any page for this one; it is a requirements file with no page of its own.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged only `past-work.md` (817 words, limit 500), which is not part of this target. I left it.

I logged one `rewrote` line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I wrote the review with verdict `fix`. It is in `review.md` in the task folder, and I made no code edits. I didn't run any probes or tests and didn't look at the page in a browser; the checks were reading the diff and the worktree files.

- **Stale docs:** `ux/Dictate/readme.md` line 30 still lists the deleted `test/anchor.mjs` as a proof. `ux/Dictate/test/files.jsonl` line 5 still declares it too.
- **Stale test:** `ux/Dictate/test/chat-sent.mjs` still asserts the "fast ✓ / smart ✓" badge text, which the owner's ask 5 now hides.
- **No re-runnable proof:** no probe script is committed, and `anchor.mjs` was the only scroll proof for the V1 sheet and is deleted. A fresh agent can't re-run the claimed results for asks 1–4 and 6.
- **Diff scope (note):** `diff.patch` covers only the last commit of the series. I confirmed the unlock-on-gesture, 40px zone, bottom-bar overlap and `display: none` code in the worktree, not in the patch.

The report also has three other notes: the pin logic exists in two places, the `earlier.mjs` failure is known and queued, and `voice-assistant.md` and `scroll.md` are accurate for the new design.
